candidate_commit_resolution_note: Do not read candidate SHA from this file; resolve the exact commit SHA directly via `git rev-parse v2/antigravity-review` (or `origin/v2/antigravity-review`) and pin that commit during independent verification.
entrypoint: python -B -m semgrepai (semgrepai.__main__ -> semgrepai.cli:app in prepared fork)
setup_instructions: 1. Checkout detached HEAD at the exact resolved commit of origin/v2/antigravity-review in an isolated workspace.
2. Verify or clone clean upstream `https://github.com/hardw00t/simple_semgrepAI.git` checked out at `2c79a58a16d11e9dea3723e30d2a7faffba7bdc9`.

3. Prepare the G1 fork into a fresh private directory outside Git: `python -B -m v2.g1_integration.prepare_g1_fork --upstream <UPSTREAM_DIR> --advisor-dir <PRIVATE_ADVISOR_DIR> --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1` (or pass `--scanner-layer ntk-cleanroom` if running on a clean server without the private advisor ZIP).
run_instructions: G1 integrated local triage: `python -B -m semgrepai scan v2/g1_integration/demo_fixtures/Demo1TruePositive.java --rules-path v2/g1_integration/rules/java_g1_cwe22_cwe89.yml --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/g1-run --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --local-triage --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M --prompt-contract blind --timeout 180`

Human review queue lifecycle: `python -B -m semgrepai queue --db <PRIVATE_OUT>/g1-run/triage/review.sqlite`, `show <ID>`, `confirm-true <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `confirm-false <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `reopen <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --reason <REASON>`, `history <ID> --include-rejected`

Full 4-scenario reproducible demo: `python -B -m v2.g1_integration.run_g1_demo --prepared-source <PRIVATE_OUT>/fork-g1/source --output-dir <PRIVATE_OUT>/demo-suite --executable <OPENGREP_BIN> --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:11434 --model qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M --timeout 180`

required_environment.opengrep: Local OpenGrep CLI binary (>=1.20.0); Semgrep is rejected by design
required_environment.ollama: Local loopback HTTP Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (verify installed model tags via /api/tags; server reference model is qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M; on Windows+WSL2 keep a WSL session active during HTTP calls so WSL2 does not auto-suspend)

known_limitations: Java context extraction is bounded to the enclosing method and same-file helper callees (<=150 lines); cross-file callees are treated as unresolved external calls and fail closed to UNDETERMINED when safety is claimed.

On the development laptop (4GB VRAM / 21 GiB free disk), `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` is installed in local WSL2 Ollama whereas `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` resides on the GPU server (`ADMIN-PC`); requesting an uninstalled tag fails closed with `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE` -> `UNDETERMINED` while keeping all alerts `OPEN` in SQLite. Independent `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` execution is expected from JavisOS on `ADMIN-PC`.
CLI `--actor` is an unauthenticated operator string for local audit trail, and SQLite does not claim OS-level tamper resistance against privileged local users.
Historical G0 findings and 14 pending errata remain untouched and locked (`G0_ACCEPTANCE=CONDITIONAL`, historical Arm C independent contribution `CONFOUNDED`).
